final: WITH g AS (SELECT m.Name AS n, AVG(t.Bytes*1.0/t.Milliseconds) AS r, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM g WHERE r IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.r), AVG(g.c), AVG(g.r - o.a) FROM g JOIN o ON o.a IS NOT NULL WHERE g.r > o.a
